claims: Amy Madigan won the 2026 Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her role as "Aunt Gladys" in Weapons.
Weapons is a supernatural horror film.
Amy Madigan plays a villainous, parasitic witch responsible for the disappearance of a class of children in Weapons.
Madigan portrays Aunt Gladys, a character requiring extensive makeup and prosthetics.
The makeup and prosthetics represent the deterioration of a witch who drains life force.
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress at the Critics' Choice Awards for her role as "Aunt Gladys" in Weapons.
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress at the SAG Actor Awards for her role as "Aunt Gladys" in Weapons.
Madigan's 2026 Academy Award win marked a 40-year gap since her last Oscar nomination for 1986's Twice in a Lifetime.
Amy Madigan described the role as a "dream part".
Amy Madigan described the role as a "survival" story.
Weapons is a Warner Bros. film.
Weapons is streamed on HBO Max.
